en: There is an Immaterial Object of Consumption (IOC) whenever the utility consumed presents itself as a position of enjoyment sustained by continuous private governance. In that case there is an immaterial product in a legally relevant sense, and art. 3, § 1, of the CDC applies<1><2>1</2></1>. The category gives concrete form to the notion of immaterial product that the law already provided for and reads it as a governed enjoyment bundle.

The hypothesis is that this update depends on a legal-analytical category capable of capturing the specificity of digital goods in a platform environment. That category is the Immaterial Object of Consumption (IOC), an infrastructure-concept that gives concrete form to the immaterial product of art. 3, § 1, of the CDC<1><2>1</2></1> and shifts the focus from the conformity of the corporeal object to the governance of the functional and symbolic architectures of the experience. The factual vulnerability of art. 4, I, of the CDC<3><4>2</4></3> takes on a form of its own there, tied to mediation by signs and interfaces and intensified by hypercuratorial anticipation, which projects images of performance, reward and future experience without offering, in the same measure, real conditions of verification. Abusive teleology makes it possible to qualify, under strict criteria, the situations in which the architecture is designed to exploit that vulnerability systematically, and protection must also cover the functional integrity of the goods and the personal and symbolic identity of the user.

Functional value equivalence is the criterion that judges whether the alteration of an IOC preserved, in substantial terms, what justified the acquisition. The test rests on art. 51, XIII, of the CDC<1><2>1</2></1>, reaches the appearance of an item when that appearance is what was bought, and leads to recomposition.

The Immaterial Object of Consumption (IOC) is the category that qualifies as an immaterial product, under art. 3, § 1, of the CDC<1><2>1</2></1>, the utility that only exists as a position of enjoyment sustained by private governance. Without this qualification the case seems to have no object, and with it the jurist knows what to demonstrate in court.

The test rests on art. 51, XIII, of the CDC<1><2>3</2></1>, reaches the appearance of an item when that appearance is what was bought, and leads to recomposition.

Intellectual property enters the regime of the IOC as part of the infrastructure through which the platform defines what can be accessed, kept, altered, withdrawn, audited and contested, and not as a topic parallel or superior to consumer protection. Exclusivity has come to organize competition and enjoyment, and the social function, read from art. 5, XXIX, of the Constitution<1><2>4</2></1>, makes it a field of reconciliation with the CDC.

The point finds support in Zelmo Denari, Antonio Herman Benjamin, Nelson Nery Jr. and Miragem, and its application is not exhausted by the text of the Code either. Art. 7 of the CDC<1><2>9</2></1> opens the microsystem to other sources, and Marques reads that opening as an updating interface, which integrates the rights secured by external legislation, but not the limits on those rights, so that it reinforces protection and never serves as a privatist escape route. Art. 47 of the CDC<3><4>10</4></3>, which requires clauses to be interpreted in the way most favorable to the consumer, already signals that unilaterally drafted ambiguities do not turn imposed precariousness into legal normality, and art. 4, I, III and VI, of the CDC<5><6>11</6></5> and art. 6, I, III, IV, VI and VIII, of the CDC<7><8>12</8></7> show a protection that applies to risk, opacity, deception, evidentiary asymmetry and unfair methods. On platforms, information, verifiability, permanence and contestation cannot be technical favors administered by whoever designs the environment. The regime of the IOC is not an extravagant construction, because utility that depends on continuous governance, unilateral reconfiguration, technical opacity and asymmetric distribution of evidence is a constitutionally qualified case for containing asymmetries.
